19805.name: Cosmos 4K SE | The 4K Smart Projector With Dolby Vision

bullets.text: All-New Portable Google TV Projector Licensed by Netflix

bullets.title: 4K Dolby Vision, Huge 200″ Screen
bullets.text: Enjoy stunning 4K visuals, 40× higher brightness, 50× better contrast, and true-to-life colors with Dolby Vision. Features a 200″ max screen size for a truly cinematic experience.

bullets.title: HybridBeam Technology for High Brightness
bullets.text: Our all-new HybridBeam technology combines LED and laser light sources to deliver 1,800 ANSI Lumens of brightness and 1.07 billion rich colors.

bullets.title: NebulaMaster Image Engine
bullets.text: Experience true-to-life colors in every frame, enhanced contrast, optimized grayscale, and smoother visuals.

bullets.title: IEA 4.0 Intelligent Setup
bullets.text: Cosmos 4K SE smartly adapts to your space using real-time autofocus and keystone correction, automatic obstacle avoidance and screen fit, wall color adaptation, ambient light adaptation, and more.

bullets.title: Google TV with 4K Netflix
bullets.text: Enjoy a personalized selection of content tailored just for you, and experience Netflix in 4K with Google TV — no external dongles needed.

bullets.title: Customized Fit
bullets.text: After customization, it can fit snugly with your Capsule Air (Google TV) equipped with power cable, adapter, remote control, snap-on base, and integrated storage.

bullets.title: Easy Portability
bullets.text: Compact in structure, with detachable shoulder strap, it can be easily stored, allowing you to carry your Capsule Air (Google TV) with you more easily than ever before.

bullets.title: Excellent Protection
bullets.text: No need to worry about dirt, dust, splashes, collisions, or scratches when packing up for a party.

bullets.title: High-Quality Materials
bullets.text: The exterior material is polyurethane waterproof material, which feels delicate and can be taken outside with no worry.

21072.name: Zolo USB-C to USB-C Cable (240W, Braided)

bullets.title: Full-Speed 240W Charging
bullets.text: Charges a 16-inch MacBook Pro (M3) to 50% in just 25 minutes and a 13-inch iPad Pro (M4) in 48 minutes, suitable for a range of powerful devices.

bullets.title: Dirt-Resistant Unibody Cable
bullets.text: Offers a stylish, unibody design with a dirt-resistant coating that prevents buildup and maintains the cable's clean appearance.

bullets.title: Sleek, Low-Profile Connector
bullets.text: Designed to charge without obstructing your phone case, with a sleek profile measuring only 5.8 mm in thickness.

bullets.title: Flexibly Strong
bullets.text: Provides a comforting soft touch with the resilience to endure over 10,000 bends.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo USB-C to USB-C Cable ( 240W, Braided), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

21098.name: Prime USB-C to USB-C Cable (240W, Upcycled-Braided)

bullets.title: Ultra-Powerful 240W Charging
bullets.text: Lead a more efficient life with the capability to boost a 16-inch MacBook Pro (M3 Pro) to 50% in just 26 minutes, thanks to the 240W power. (Note: This cable does not support screen mirroring.Data based on internal lab testing. Actual results may vary depending on individual use and other factors.)
Engineered to withstand over 300,000 bends, this USB 2.0 cable offers peace of mind for decades to come.

bullets.title: Extreme Temperature Resilience
bullets.text: Keep your devices powered in any climate, performing flawlessly even after 72 hours in extreme temperatures from -40°F to 176°F. (Note: Please check that your devices can operate in extreme environments before use.)

bullets.title: Sustainably Made Cable
bullets.text: Support a greener future with each use, featuring an outer layer crafted from 100% post-consumer recycled materials.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Prime USB-C to USB-C Cable (6 ft, 240W, Upcycled-Braided), cord organizer, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Superior Display, Swift Connectivity
bullets.text: Elevate your viewing experience to unparalleled clarity with 8K@60Hz, and enjoy smoother visuals and reduced lag with support for 4K@120Hz and 4K@60Hz.

bullets.title: Quick and Seamless Video Transfer
bullets.text: With the latest HDMI 2.1 technology, stream or transfer videos without interruptions, and witness the power of up to 48 Gbps in bandwidth, ensuring consistently clear content.

bullets.title: Lasts Longer, Performs Stronger
bullets.text: This cable is designed to withstand up to 1,000 bends throughout its lifespan, meaning fewer replacements and continuous peace of mind.

bullets.title: One Cable, Many Solutions
bullets.text: Whether you're connecting tablets, laptops, HDMI devices, projectors, or desktop screens, this cable effortlessly connects them all.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: HDMI Cable (6 ft, 8K), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Data Transfer Goes Green
bullets.text: Upgrade to a greener data transfer experience. About 40% of this cable's exterior is composed of bio-based materials from corn and sugarcane, reducing petroleum usage by 30-40%.

bullets.title: Flicker-Free Data Excellence
bullets.text: Get ready for super smooth data transfer at 20 Gbps. No more flickers, ghosting, or frame drops for efficient user experience, backed by USB-IF certification.

bullets.title: Elevate Your Viewing with 4K
bullets.text: Experience a visual masterpiece with 4K@60Hz visuals, unleashing stunning clarity and lifelike details on your screen.

bullets.title: One Cable, Many Devices
bullets.text: Power up all your devices with this 240W universal charging cable — whether it's a smartphone, iPad, MacBook, or gaming console.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker USB-C to USB-C Cable (3 ft, 240W, 20 Gbps, Bio-Based), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: 240W Ultra-Fast Charging
bullets.text: Quickly charge your devices with 240W fast charging. Power a 14-inch MacBook Pro (M3) from 0 to 50% in just 29 minutes.

bullets.title: 40Gbps Transfer Speed
bullets.text: Share and transfer files at unprecedented speeds of up to 40Gbps. Transfer 2.5GB files in just one second.

bullets.title: Single 8K or Dual 4K Displays
bullets.text: Enjoy ultra-clear visuals whether streaming in 8K or multitasking with dual 4K displays.

bullets.title: Thunderbolt 4-Certified
bullets.text: Experience safe and fast charging along with data transfer, backed by Thunderbolt 4 certification and USB4 compliance.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Prime Thunderbolt 4 Cable (3.3 ft, 240W, 40Gbps), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

21232.name: Nano 75W Car Charger (Built-In Retractable USB-C Cable)

bullets.title: Full-Throttle 75W USB-C Charging
bullets.text: Power up rapidly with a charger that delivers up to 75W, giving you super-fast charging when you need it most.

bullets.title: Dual-Device Power Delivery
bullets.text: Experience rapid charging with the built-in 45W Power Delivery retractable cable and 30W USB-C port, perfect for powering up laptops and tablets together without slowing down.

bullets.title: Pull, Charge, and Store
bullets.text: Extend by pulling the retractable cable more than 2 inches. Retract swiftly with a short pull and release.

bullets.title: Keep Your Car Organized
bullets.text: Drive in style with a clutter-free charger that keeps your car's interior neat and orderly.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Nano Car Charger (75W, USB-C Port, Built-In Retractable USB-C Cable), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Outstanding Temperature Control Upgrade
bullets.text: A More Assured Safety Experience. Redefining industry standards, our product's temperature control surpasses national standards, maintaining a temperature 13 degrees Celsius lower. Among Anker chargers, the 30W compact charger stands out with the lowest temperature.

bullets.title: Fashionable Low-Temperature Experience
bullets.text: With higher energy density and a cooler temperature experience, our product meets your dual expectations: compact and stylish appearance combined with a low-temperature experience. The appearance is petite, stylish, and aesthetically pleasing.

bullets.title: Exquisite Design
bullets.text: The product design integrates the same color scheme as the iPhone, presenting a refined appearance. With innovative stacking technology, it is 25% smaller than the original.

bullets.title: High-Speed Charging
bullets.text: Equipped with a USB-C power port and a maximum power of 30W, it can charge smartphones, tablets, etc., at a speed three times faster than the original charger.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo Charger (30W), welcome guide, our worry-free 12-month warranty, and friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Power Trio for Simultaneous Fast Charging
bullets.text: With dual USB-C ports and a USB-A port, this Anker prime charger allows you to simultaneously fast charge three devices, ensuring your gadgets stay powered up even on the busiest of days.

bullets.title: Compact and Portable Powerhouse
bullets.text: This ultra-compact 100W USB C charger from Anker is 43% smaller than the original 96W MacBook charger, making it effortlessly portable and ideal for travel, easily fitting into any bag or purse.

bullets.title: Advanced Safety with ActiveShield 2.0
bullets.text: Equipped with advanced GaN Prime technology and the ActiveShield 2.0 safety system, this charger safeguards your devices from electrical anomalies, providing peace of mind with its innovative safety features.

bullets.title: Complete Package
bullets.text: Included in the box is the Anker Prime 100W GaN Wall Charger (3 Ports), a welcome guide, and Anker's worry-free 12-month warranty backed by friendly customer service.

21301.name: Charging Base 100W for Anker Prime Power Bank

bullets.title: Wireless Charging Convenience
bullets.text: Experience hassle-free recharging with the Anker 100W Charging Base, designed to wirelessly charge compatible Anker power banks (excluding the Anker 737 Power Bank) for an instant boost up to 100W.

bullets.title: Versatile 4-in-1 Fast Charging
bullets.text: With a total output of 100W shared among 3 USB ports and 1 Pogo pin, this charging base efficiently powers your essential devices simultaneously.

bullets.title: Compact GaN Design
bullets.text: Leveraging GaN technology, the charging base offers reliable, high-powered charging in a compact size, comparable to an original 96W single-port charger.

bullets.title: Smart LED Indicator
bullets.text: Monitor the charging status of your Anker Prime Power Bank with ease, thanks to the intuitive LED indicator that flashes during wireless recharging and remains steady when fully charged.

bullets.title: Complete Package
bullets.text: Includes the Anker 100W Charging Base, power cord, welcome guide, and a worry-free 12-month warranty, backed by Anker's friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Ultimate Charging Station
bullets.text: Experience the power of Anker's Prime Charger (250W, 6 Ports, GaNPrime), a cutting-edge charging solution that efficiently charges up to six devices simultaneously.

bullets.title: Blazing Fast USB-C Charging
bullets.text: With its 140W USB-C port, this charger can power up your 16-inch MacBook Pro to 50% in just 25 minutes, boosting your productivity like never before.

bullets.title: Intelligent Charging Control
bullets.text: The 2.26-inch LCD display provides real-time feedback on charging status and speed, while the smart control dial lets you fine-tune energy output for optimal charging across devices.

bullets.title: Versatile Compatibility
bullets.text: Designed to fuel a wide range of devices, including the latest iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, and tablet models, ensuring seamless charging for all your essentials.

bullets.title: Built for Reliability
bullets.text: Backed by Anker's 12-month warranty and renowned customer service, the Prime Charger offers peace of mind with its safety certifications and durable construction.

bullets.title: Seamless Connectivity
bullets.text: Unleash the full potential of this charger by registering with the Anker application, enabling IoT capabilities and personalized charging experiences. (Note: Supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi)
